title: Topic 9
japanese_text: <u>再三</u>注意したにも関わらず、部下がまた同じミスをした。ミスのたびに一緒に頭を下げ、何度も<u>助言</u>を与えてきたが、もう<u>かばい</u>きれない。本当に<u>うんざり</u>する。
english_translation: There's a junior employee who has just made the same mistake, despite me warning him over and over again. Every time he makes a mistake, I have to apologize alongside him, and I have given him advice so many times, but I can't cover for him anymore. I'm finding it really tiresome.
